title: Measure trust grant, denial and revocation against the pinned runtime
statement: Determine whether 0.84.4 exposes a supported API, command or non-interactive option for recording, reading and revoking a project trust decision. Observe the result through a marker written at extension load time, upstream of any model behaviour, with the 2026-08-18 control set: untrusted, granted, explicitly denied, and grant removed. Record the answer to QST-0026 and stop for review if no supported route exists.
